notes: Model catalog for ImageMango. Edit freely; a copy placed in %LOCALAPPDATA%\ImageMango\config\models.json overrides this one. 'tiers' pick files and settings by GPU VRAM: the tier with the largest minVramGb not above this machine's VRAM wins, and its settings are layered over 'defaults'. 'family' is the model type LoRAs must be made for (see LoraFamilies in Core/Lora.cs); loraCivitai / loraHuggingFace optionally pick which LoRA listings 'Find LoRAs' opens. Categories: filtered = publisher states training data was filtered / safety-tuned; unfiltered = no stated filtering, will follow explicit prompts; nfaa = Hugging Face repo is tagged not-for-all-audiences.

models.name: Z-Image Turbo
models.description: 6B distilled model; photoreal, strong prompt following and English/Chinese text. 8 steps, very fast. Best all-round pick for a 12 GB GPU.
models.tips: Write natural sentences. CFG stays at 1 (no negative prompt).
models.promptGuide: One paragraph of plain, concrete English sentences, 40 to 90 words: the kind of image (photo, illustration, poster), the subject and what it is doing, the setting, the light, the camera or art style, the mood. Photoreal unless the user asks for a style. Words that must appear in the image go in double quotes. No tag lists and no quality words like 'masterpiece' or '8k'.
samplePrompts: A candid street photo of an elderly tea seller in Chengdu at dawn, steam rising from a copper kettle, soft golden backlight, 35mm film look
A neon sign above a narrow Hong Kong alley that reads '夜市 NIGHT MARKET' in glowing red and blue tubes, wet pavement reflections, light rain
Studio product photo of a matte black earbud case on white marble, single hard light from the left, crisp shadow, minimalist
A chalkboard menu outside a Paris café listing 'Croissant 2€, Café crème 3€, Tarte du jour 5€', morning sunlight, red geraniums
Portrait of a young Indian woman in a mustard-yellow saree laughing on a Mumbai rooftop at golden hour, natural skin texture, 85mm bokeh

models.name: FLUX.2 [klein] 4B
models.description: Small 4-step distilled FLUX.2. Fastest model in this list with good quality; commercial use allowed.
models.promptGuide: Natural English sentences, 30 to 70 words. Subject first, then what it is doing, the setting, the style or medium (photo, gouache illustration, 3D render), the light and the framing. Be specific about colours and materials. Words that must appear in the image go in double quotes. No tag lists and no filler like 'masterpiece' or '8k'.

models.name: FLUX.2 [klein] 9B
models.description: Larger 4-step FLUX.2 with noticeably better detail and text than 4B. Non-commercial licence.
models.promptGuide: Natural English sentences, 30 to 80 words. Subject first, then what it is doing, the setting, the style or medium, the light and the framing. It renders text well: put the exact words in double quotes and say where they go and how they look. Be specific about colours and materials. No tag lists and no filler like 'masterpiece' or '8k'.
samplePrompts: A botanical illustration of a monstera plant with neat handwritten labels 'Leaf', 'Aerial root', 'Node' on aged paper
Cinematic wide shot of a desert caravan at dusk under a giant ringed planet, long shadows, volumetric dust, anamorphic flare

models.name: Qwen-Image 2.1
models.description: 7B successor to the 20B Qwen-Image: best text rendering and layout in this list, bilingual (English/Chinese) text and native 2K output. Much lighter than Qwen-Image 2512, so it runs comfortably on 12 GB. Non-commercial licence.
models.promptGuide: Long, descriptive English prose, 60 to 140 words, like an art director's brief: the kind of image (poster, photo, infographic, illustration), the layout and composition, the subject, the style, colours and light. It is the best model here for text: put every word that must appear in double quotes, and say where it goes, how big and in what lettering. Chinese text is fine inside quotes. No tag lists.
models.tips: Write long, descriptive prose and put the exact text in quotes. CFG 1 is about twice as fast but ignores the negative prompt.

models.name: Chroma1-HD
models.description: 8.9B FLUX.1-schnell derivative retrained on a broad uncensored dataset. Wide style range; uses real CFG with negative prompts.
models.tips: 26 steps, CFG 4. Use the negative prompt.
models.promptGuide: Natural English description, 40 to 90 words, that names the medium and style explicitly (oil painting, 35mm film photo, anime illustration, watercolour) and then describes the subject, the setting, the light and the composition. It knows many art styles and artists' techniques; say which one. Write the negative prompt as unwanted qualities (low quality, blurry, deformed hands).

defaults.negativePrompt: low quality, ugly, unfinished, out of focus, deformed, disfigured, blurry, smudged, restricted palette, flat colors

models.name: RealVisXL V5.0
models.description: Popular photoreal SDXL fine-tune. Fast on any GPU and compatible with thousands of SDXL LoRAs.
models.tips: Tag-style or sentence prompts; use the negative prompt.
models.promptGuide: A photographic description, 25 to 60 words, as short comma-separated phrases. Start with 'RAW photo,' then the shot type (close-up portrait, full body, wide shot), the subject with concrete details (age, hair, clothing, expression), what they do, the setting, the light (soft window light, golden hour), and camera details (85mm, f/1.8, film grain, detailed skin). Photoreal only; avoid art-style words unless asked. Negative prompt: illustration, painting, cartoon, 3d, low quality, blurry, deformed hands.

defaults.negativePrompt: (worst quality, low quality, illustration, 3d, 2d, painting, cartoons, sketch), open mouth

models.name: Illustrious XL v2.0
models.description: Anime / illustration SDXL base trained on Danbooru tags; base of most current anime fine-tunes.
models.tips: Danbooru tags work best, e.g. '1girl, solo, masterpiece, best quality, ...'.
models.promptGuide: Comma-separated Danbooru tags in lowercase, no sentences. Order: 'masterpiece, best quality', the count tag (1girl, 1boy, 2girls, multiple girls, no humans), 'solo' if one person, a character and series name only if the user named one, then appearance (hair colour and length, eye colour, clothing), pose and action, expression, setting and background, light and weather, and framing (upper body, full body, from above, looking at viewer). Use real Danbooru tag names. Negative prompt: short quality tags (worst quality, low quality, lowres, bad anatomy, bad hands, watermark).

defaults.negativePrompt: worst quality, low quality, lowres, bad anatomy, bad hands, jpeg artifacts, signature, watermark

models.tips: Start prompts with 'masterpiece, best quality, newest, absurdres, highres'.
models.promptGuide: Comma-separated Danbooru tags in lowercase, no sentences. Always start with 'masterpiece, best quality, newest, absurdres, highres'. It also knows tags for animal characters. Use real tag names. Negative prompt: short quality tags (worst quality, old, early, low quality, lowres, bad hands, signature, watermark).

models.name: WAI-illustrious-SDXL v17
models.description: The most downloaded anime SDXL fine-tune (formerly WAI-NSFW-illustrious), built on Illustrious XL. Clean, vivid anime style with strong character knowledge. Tagged not-for-all-audiences. Downloaded from a Hugging Face mirror (IbarakiDouji) whose file matches the official Civitai v17 checksum.
models.promptGuide: Comma-separated Danbooru tags in lowercase, no sentences, 15 to 30 tags. Always start with 'masterpiece,best quality,amazing quality,'. Then the count tag (1girl, 1boy, 2girls, no humans), 'solo' if one person, a character and series name only if the user named one, then appearance, clothing, pose, expression, setting, light, framing. End with the rating tag 'general'; use 'sensitive' instead only when the user explicitly asks for a suggestive image. Keep the negative prompt short: bad quality, worst quality, worst detail, sketch, censor, and 'nsfw' unless the user asks for adult content.
models.tips: Danbooru tags. Start with 'masterpiece,best quality,amazing quality,' and keep quality tags and the negative prompt short; long ones blur the image. Rating tags control content: general, sensitive, nsfw, explicit. Put 'nsfw' in the negative prompt to keep results safe. Use sizes above 1024x1024, e.g. 1024x1344.

defaults.negativePrompt: bad quality, worst quality, worst detail, sketch, censor

models.name: REDCraft REDZ v1.5 (Z-Image Turbo)
models.description: Community Z-Image Turbo fine-tune focused on uncensored realism. Tagged not-for-all-audiences. Ships as BF16, quantized to Q8 while loading (slower first load).
models.tips: Same as Z-Image Turbo: 8 steps, CFG 1.
models.promptGuide: One paragraph of plain, concrete English sentences, 40 to 90 words, written like a caption for a realistic photo: the kind of shot, the subject (people with an adult age), what they are doing, the setting, the light, the lens or film look, the mood. Words that must appear in the image go in double quotes. No tag lists and no quality words like 'masterpiece' or '8k'.

models.name: Noct Q V4 (Qwen-Image 2.1)
models.description: Uncensored photoreal fine-tune of Qwen-Image 2.1 that keeps the base model's readable text and also does anime and painted styles. Tagged not-for-all-audiences. Ships as a 7.3 GB INT8 file that the engine runs directly.
models.promptGuide: English prose like a detailed photo caption, 50 to 110 words: the kind of shot first (a photograph of, a close-up of), then the person with an adult age ('a woman in her twenties'), their look and clothing, what they do, where, the light, and the framing and camera angle. It can also do anime and painted styles if the style is named first. Text that must appear goes in double quotes. No tag lists. Negative prompt: artifacts, low quality, blurry, bad hands, wrong number of fingers.
models.tips: Write prose like a photo caption: the kind of shot, then the person with an adult age ('a woman in her twenties'), what they do, where, the light, the framing. No tag lists. CFG 3 with the negative prompt follows prompts best; CFG 1 is about twice as fast but ignores the negative.

defaults.negativePrompt: artifacts, washed-out colors, low quality, low resolution, blurry, indistinct, missing fingers, badly drawn hands, wrong number of fingers
